description_en: Enables or modifies the audit log settings for a Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) database instance
description_zh: 开启或修改云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的审计日志设置
name: ModifyAuditLogConfig

parameters.help_en: Instance ID of the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473778.html operation to query instance ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of days for which audit logs are retained. Valid values: 1 to 365.
This parameter is required when DbAudit is set to true.
The setting of this parameter takes effect on all instances in the current region
parameters.help_zh:
审计日志保留天数，取值：1~365。
当DbAudit取值为true时，本参数必须传入。
本参数的设置对当前地域下的所有实例生效
parameters.name: retention

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the audit log feature. Valid values:
true: enables the feature. This is the default value.
false: disables the feature.

If the instance uses the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/52228.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62870.html, the audit logs of data nodes and proxy nodes are enabled or disabled at the same time. You cannot enable the audit logs for data nodes or proxy nodes separately
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启审计日志，取值：
true：默认值，开启。
false：关闭。

当实例为https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/52228.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62870.html时，会同时开启或关闭数据节点和代理节点的审计日志，不支持单独开启
parameters.name: db_audit
